"""Final-dashboard datasets: trades (all IPL 2027 moves), the full availability list (everyone not in a 2027 squad who played
IPL or full-member T20Is in 2025-26), and the best-available top 10s on the same pressure ratings as step 2."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, pathlib
W = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/work"); O = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/dash8"); O.mkdir(exist_ok=True); CODE = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
sq27 = pd.read_csv(W / "squads2027.csv"); in27 = set(sq27.player_id.dropna().astype(int)); pool = pd.read_csv(W / "pool2027.csv")
rel = dict(zip(pool.player_id, pool.released_by))
EX = {"Harry Brook": "Banned", "Andre Russell": "Retired", "Ajinkya Rahane": "Retired", "Ravichandran Ashwin": "Retired", "Mahendra Singh Dhoni": "Retired from IPL",
      "Travis Head": "Reported to miss IPL 2027"}
b = pd.read_parquet(W / "balls_pi.parquet", columns=["fmt", "year", "striker_id", "striker_name", "bowler_id", "bowler_name", "batting_order", "bowling_type", "legal", "faced", "batting_team_id", "bowling_team_id"])
t = pd.read_csv(W / "40666adb-teams.csv")
FULL = {"India", "England", "West Indies", "Australia", "Sri Lanka", "South Africa", "Bangladesh", "Zimbabwe", "Afghanistan", "New Zealand", "Pakistan", "Ireland"}
fid = set(t[t.team_name.isin(FULL)].team_id)
rec = b[(b.year >= 2025) & ((b.fmt == "IPL") | ((b.fmt == "T20I") & b.batting_team_id.isin(fid) & b.bowling_team_id.isin(fid)))]
bat = rec[rec.faced].groupby("striker_id").agg(name=("striker_name", "first"), balls_faced=("faced", "size"), pos=("batting_order", "median"))
bowl = rec[rec.legal].groupby("bowler_id").agg(name=("bowler_name", "first"), balls_bowled=("legal", "size"), btype=("bowling_type", lambda x: x.mode().iat[0] if x.notna().any() else None))
A = bat.join(bowl[["balls_bowled", "btype"]], how="outer"); A["name"] = A["name"].fillna(bowl.name)
A = A[~A.index.isin(in27)]
A = A[(A.balls_faced.fillna(0) >= 30) | (A.balls_bowled.fillna(0) >= 60)]
mp = pd.read_csv(W / "41b3fbfd-competition_team_player_mapping.csv")
IPLT = set(pd.read_csv(W / "squads2026.csv").team_name)
natm = mp[~mp.team_name.isin(IPLT)]
nat = natm.groupby("player_id").team_name.agg(lambda x: x.mode().iat[0]).replace({"India A": "India"})
A["country"] = A.index.map(nat).fillna("India"); A = A[A.country != "Pakistan"]
A["overseas"] = np.where(A.country == "India", "Indian", "Overseas")
ipl_ids = set(b[b.fmt == "IPL"].striker_id) | set(b[b.fmt == "IPL"].bowler_id)
A["status"] = [("Released by " + rel[i]) if i in rel else ("Played IPL, not in a 2027 squad" if i in ipl_ids else "Never played IPL") for i in A.index]
A["note"] = A.name.map(EX).fillna(pd.Series(A.index.map(dict(zip(pool.player_id, pool.note.fillna("")))), index=A.index)).fillna("")
def role(r):
    bb, bf = r.balls_bowled if pd.notna(r.balls_bowled) else 0, r.balls_faced if pd.notna(r.balls_faced) else 0
    bt = str(r.btype or "").replace("Right-arm fast-medium", "Right-arm pace").replace("Right-arm medium-fast", "Right-arm pace").replace("Left-arm fast-medium", "Left-arm pace").replace("Left-arm medium-fast", "Left-arm pace")
    if bb >= 120 and bf >= 120: return "All-rounder (" + bt + ")"
    if bb >= 60: return "Bowler (" + bt + ")"
    p = r.pos
    return "Batter, " + ("top order" if p <= 3 else "middle order" if p <= 5 else "finisher")
A["role"] = A.apply(role, axis=1)
rb = pd.read_csv(W / "fin2_ratings_bat.csv", index_col=0); rw = pd.read_csv(W / "fin2_ratings_bowl.csv", index_col=0)
rb["r"] = range(1, len(rb) + 1); rw["r"] = range(1, len(rw) + 1)
A["bat_pressure_rank"] = A.index.map(rb.r); A["bowl_pressure_rank"] = A.index.map(rw.r)
S = pd.read_csv(W / "auction_scores.csv"); NEED = {"N1": "Finisher v right-arm pace", "N2": "No. 8-11 hitting", "N3": "Death overs 16-18", "N4": "Middle overs v left-handers", "N5": "New ball v right-handers"}
best = S[S.balls >= 20].sort_values("value", ascending=False).drop_duplicates("pid").set_index("pid")
A["best_rr_fit"] = A.index.map(best.need.map(NEED)); A["best_fit_value"] = A.index.map(best.value).round(2)
A["best_fit_balls"] = A.index.map(best.balls)
A = A.reset_index(names="pid").sort_values(["bat_pressure_rank", "bowl_pressure_rank"])
A["best_pressure_rank"] = A[["bat_pressure_rank", "bowl_pressure_rank"]].min(axis=1)
A = A.sort_values("best_pressure_rank", na_position="last")
cols = ["name", "country", "overseas", "role", "status", "note", "bat_pressure_rank", "bowl_pressure_rank", "best_rr_fit", "best_fit_value", "best_fit_balls", "balls_faced", "balls_bowled"]
A[cols].to_csv(W / "available2027.csv", index=False)
def topavail(kind):
    r = pd.read_csv(W / f"fin2_ratings_{kind}.csv", index_col=0); r["overall_rank"] = range(1, len(r) + 1)
    a = r[~r.index.isin(in27) & (r.last_team != "Pakistan") & ~r.name.isin(EX)].copy()
    a["status"] = [("Released by " + rel[i]) if i in rel else ("Played IPL, not in a 2027 squad" if pd.notna(x) else "Never played IPL") for i, x in zip(a.index, a.ipl_team_latest)]
    a["country"] = a.index.map(nat).fillna("India"); a["top10_in_resamples_pct"] = (100 * a.boot_top10).round(0)
    a["note"] = a.name.map({"Mustafizur Rahman": "Check availability (Bangladesh)"}).fillna("")
    a = a.head(10).copy(); a["rank"] = range(1, 11)
    return a[["rank", "name", "country", "status", "overall_rank", "top10_in_resamples_pct"] + (["SR_P", "SR_N"] if kind == "bat" else ["Econ_P", "Econ_N"]) + ["note"]].round(1)
TB, TW = topavail("bat"), topavail("bowl")
TR = pd.DataFrame([
 ("Rishabh Pant", "Lucknow Super Giants", "Delhi Capitals", "15 cr (was 27 cr)", "Swap with Kuldeep Yadav"),
 ("Kuldeep Yadav", "Delhi Capitals", "Lucknow Super Giants", "13.5 cr", "Swap with Rishabh Pant"),
 ("Hardik Pandya", "Mumbai Indians", "Punjab Kings", "18 cr", "Swap with Arshdeep Singh"),
 ("Arshdeep Singh", "Punjab Kings", "Mumbai Indians", "18 cr", "Swap with Hardik Pandya"),
 ("T Natarajan", "Delhi Capitals", "Sunrisers Hyderabad", "5 cr", "Swap with Zeeshan Ansari"),
 ("Zeeshan Ansari", "Sunrisers Hyderabad", "Delhi Capitals", "0.4 cr", "Swap with T Natarajan"),
 ("Liam Livingstone", "Sunrisers Hyderabad", "Chennai Super Kings", "", "Four-player swap"),
 ("Jack Edwards", "Sunrisers Hyderabad", "Chennai Super Kings", "", "Four-player swap"),
 ("Khaleel Ahmed", "Chennai Super Kings", "Sunrisers Hyderabad", "", "Four-player swap"),
 ("Nathan Ellis", "Chennai Super Kings", "Sunrisers Hyderabad", "", "Four-player swap"),
 ("Harshal Patel", "Sunrisers Hyderabad", "Gujarat Titans", "", ""),
 ("Mohammed Shami", "Lucknow Super Giants", "Rajasthan Royals", "", "For Sam Curran"),
 ("Manimaran Siddharth", "Lucknow Super Giants", "Rajasthan Royals", "", "For Sam Curran"),
 ("Sam Curran", "Rajasthan Royals", "Lucknow Super Giants", "", "For Shami and Siddharth"),
], columns=["player", "from_team", "to_team", "fee", "deal"])
TR["involves_rr"] = np.where((TR.from_team == "Rajasthan Royals") | (TR.to_team == "Rajasthan Royals"), "Yes", "No")
def dump(name, df, inputs):
    rws = json.loads(df.replace({np.nan: None}).to_json(orient="records"))
    (O / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"rows": rws, "meta": [{"label": "s36_final_data.py", "value": CODE, "type": "code", "lang": "python"}, {"label": "Input", "value": inputs}]}))
    print(name, len(rws))
dump("available", A[cols], "squads2027.csv (retained lists, 18 Nov 2026), balls_pi IPL + full-member T20Is 2025-26, fin2 ratings, auction_scores.csv")
dump("avail_bat", TB, "fin2_ratings_bat.csv minus 2027 squads"); dump("avail_bowl", TW, "fin2_ratings_bowl.csv minus 2027 squads")
dump("trades", TR, "Trade reports: myKhel, Cricbat, Yahoo trade tracker, Rajasthan Royals (to 18 Nov 2026)")
pd.set_option("display.width", 250); print(TB.to_string(index=False)); print(TW.to_string(index=False))
print(A[cols].head(25).to_string(index=False)); print(A.status.value_counts())
